title: Buisness Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst (Data & AI Platforms)**

**Company:** Exceliq Consulting (India) Pvt. Ltd.  
**Client:** NA  
**Role:** Business Analyst  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Location:** As per Client Requirement/Onsite/Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail oriented Business Analyst to support strategic Data Engineering, AI, and GenAI initiatives for NA. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders, data teams, and technology partners by translating complex business requirements into scalable data and AI driven solutions.

The role requires strong experience in data mapping, business process analysis, data transformation requirements, stakeholder management, and documentation for enterprise data platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders across multiple functions.
* Conduct workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, and discovery meetings to understand current and future state processes.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications.
* Create Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as the primary liaison between business users, data engineering teams, architects, and project managers.

**Data Mapping & Transformation Analysis**

* Analyze source-to-target data mapping requirements across multiple enterprise systems.
* Define and document data transformation rules, business logic, metadata requirements, and validation criteria.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure accurate mapping between source and target data structures.
* Review mapping specifications including source attributes, target attributes, transformation logic, reference data, and business rules.
* Support data quality, reconciliation, lineage, and governance initiatives.

**AI / GenAI Solution Enablement**

* Work closely with AI and Data Engineering teams to define business requirements for LLM-powered and intelligent automation solutions.
* Assist in identifying mapping patterns, historical business rules, and transformation standards for AI-driven recommendations.
* Participate in validation and evaluation of AI-generated outputs from a business perspective.
* Define approval workflows, confidence thresholds, governance controls, and exception management processes for automated recommendations.
* Support adoption and continuous improvement of GenAI-enabled business processes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business leaders, product owners, architects, developers, and QA teams.
* Facilitate requirement reviews, walkthroughs, and sign-off sessions.
* Communicate project status, dependencies, risks, and impacts to key stakeholders.
* Manage requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

**Testing & Validation**

* Define business acceptance criteria and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Review test scenarios, test cases, and validation outcomes.
* Ensure delivered solutions align with approved business requirements and expected outcomes.
* Participate in defect triaging and resolution discussions.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Functional Skills**

* Strong experience in Business Analysis within Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Warehousing, or Digital Transformation projects.
* Expertise in requirement gathering, documentation, stakeholder management, and process analysis.
* Experience with source-to-target mapping, data transformation analysis, and data governance practices.
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of data quality, data lineage, and data validation concepts.

**Technical Understanding**

* Good understanding of SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Data Lakes, and modern data platforms.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data integration frameworks.
* Exposure to AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), is highly preferred.
* Awareness of REST APIs, Git-based development practices, and cloud-based data ecosystems.

**Business & Communication Skills**

* Excellent analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking abilities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Databricks based Data Engineering environments.
* Exposure to Data Mapping Automation, Metadata Management, or AI assisted Data Platforms.
* Experience working with enterprise scale data transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Certification in Business Analysis (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery teams.

**Key Deliverables**

* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS)
* User Stories & Acceptance Criteria
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Source-to-Target Mapping Documents
* Data Validation & Reconciliation Documentation
* UAT Sign-off Documents
* Stakeholder Communication Reports

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Master's degree (MBA, MCA, or equivalent) is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Agile BA, or Scrum certifications will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra

title: Senior Manager CTO Cloud Engineering
description:
**About M&G India**

We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

**About M&G**

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver complex Azure infrastructure solutions ensuring security and governance best practices are followed
* Embrace and adapt to the changing environment by developing applications or script in the language of choice.
* Torch bearer for the team – being a SME or go to person for the product/project. Validate and challenge the technical changes by maintaining the high standard for the delivery. Keep very relevant to the technology space.
* Can develop products with little instructions, should be able to troubleshoot in case of adverse incident and should be able to dissect complex problems.
* Should be able to Mentor the team members, proactively look for sharing the knowledge and encourage collaboration.
* Should be able to clearly articulate business values to the senior stakeholders and manage their expectation well.
* Understand the risk and controls around the applications running in cloud.
* Follow the software development lifecycle defined within the team .
* Be able to appreciate truly Agile ways of working/development using tools like Jira/Confluence.
* Collaborate with peers across various levels for experiential learnings.
* Focus on Scalability, resilience, security, quality and continuous rigour to reduce technical debt.
* Advance the cloud community through sharing of best practice and mentoring others.
* Create and maintain build and release pipelines across Azure DevOps projects in order to support infrastructure deployments.

**Knowledge & Skills:**

**Required**

* Automation and **DevOps** at the heart of all work you tackle
* Created solutions using **containerisation** and hands on experience in **Kubernetes** implementations (Preferably **Azure redhat Openshift /** **OpenShift)**
* Proficiency in developing infrastructure automation scripts using **Terraform**
* Thorough understanding of **Continuous integration and continuous delivery** using **YAML** & **Azure DevOps.**
* Comfortable with **ARM templates, Shell script and Azure Power Shell** scripts which can then be provided to application teams as consumables.
* Good working and hands on knowledge of **Azure core infrastructure resources**
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to independently solve problems and build robust solutions and enjoy working with minimal supervision within an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Proficiency in Integration of various Azure resources (**IaaS and PaaS** - SQL DB, App Service, Application Insights, Storage accounts etc) to deliver an end-to-end automation.
* Proficiency and thorough understanding of **Azure RBAC model**.
* Good grasp of **Azure governance principles** and hands-on experience in rolling out compliance and governance polices.
* Knowledge around building VM images using **Packer/Ansible** or any config management tool.
* Sound understanding of networking knowledge on DNS and Firewall security like Palo Alto.
* Experience with containers, registries, and related orchestration technologies (**Kubernetes**, **Helm** **charts** ). Knowledge of **GitOps** and the most common tools

**Experience:**

Minimum 7-10 years of relevant experience and 10 years of industry experience who can showcase delivering with the help of the team by taking responsibility end to end

**Educational Qualification:**

* Graduate/Masters in any discipline
* Cloud certifications would be an added advantage

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.
